page.overview:
Who is Menato Boffa?

Menato Boffa (born 4 January 1930 and died 28 September 1996) was an Italian racing driver who participated in five non-championship Formula One races in as a privateer. He also entered the 1961 Italian Grand Prix, but withdrew before the start of the event.

Boffa raced in Formula Junior in 1960 before graduating to Formula One in a Cooper T45 he purchased the following year. He finished 5th in his Formula One debut at the non-championship 1961 Vienna Grand Prix, although only nine cars started that race.

He finished 9th in Syracuse and crashed with Keith Greene five laps into the Naples Grand Prix. His final non-championship entry was at the 1961 Modena Grand Prix, but he failed to qualify.

At the end of the season, he disappeared from international competition.
